trends.name: AI Infrastructure Mega-Cap Spending
sources: CNBC Markets
Microsoft plans to raise $25 billion in debt as it pursues AI buildout
Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate
trends.summary: Tech giants are embarking on massive, multi-billion-dollar capital expenditure programs, primarily fueling AI buildouts and cloud expansion. This suggests continued enterprise investment despite economic slowdown fears, making mega-cap infrastructure plays highly attractive.

trends.name: Tech Sector Weakness & Divergence
sources: Intel stock plunges 21% as chipmaker blames PC slowdown for weak guidance
Reddit shares sink on weak sales guidance...
Amazon’s stock drops — even in the face of a bold new cloud forecast
Amazon posts negative free cash flow...
trends.summary: While cloud services (AWS) demonstrate robust growth, weakness is emerging in consumer-facing tech sectors, prompting sharp drops in chipmakers and social platforms. Investors must differentiate between resilient cloud spending and struggling consumer revenue.

trends.name: Global Interest Rate Uncertainty
sources: Rates Spark: Hikes Coming, But Bond Yields Choosing To Fall
BOJ holds rates as underlying inflation aligns with 2% target for first time since 2013
trends.summary: Monetary policy remains highly unpredictable, with differing central bank signals (BOJ holding steady vs. implied Fed pivot). Falling bond yields contrasting with hawkish rate speech creates mixed signals for fixed income and equity duration plays.

trends.name: Geopolitical Risk & Election Cycle
sources: Israel faces weeks of coalition haggling as Netanyahu’s party claims election 'stolen'
Elections worldwide are testing Trump’s influence abroad
The midterms are crucial to the future of Social Security
DOJ escalates Alaska Senate lawsuit over dueling Sullivan candidacies
trends.summary: Intense global political volatility is dominating headlines, from ongoing conflicts in the Middle East to domestic political risk around the midterms. Policy uncertainty regarding social safety nets (like Social Security) presents persistent risk.

trends.name: Financial Resilience & Real Estate
